c19_click_to_select.assessment: The sanitized native report records the selected Cedar chair preview, the returned selector displayed in Data, one DOM match for that selector, and identity with the clicked Cedar chair element. Exact source at the recorded source SHA confirms the picker item was checked before a trusted pointer click on Done; the driver then awaited one returned field and asserted the selector matched exactly one Cedar chair element. This supports only the bounded guest C19 action on this imported artifact.

first_failure.assessment: After Done returns the selected field to Data and the driver records C19, the source immediately asks for the 'Pick fields on this page' button again. At the exact source SHA, DataView conditionally replaces that button whenever hasFields is true; the guest view instead shows Data-level Cancel and Sign in to save. The native failure diagnostic confirms zero picker-button matches, one active Data pane, and a visible Sign in to save button. The requested target is absent by design in the observed post-Done state, so this is a stale harness precondition rather than evidence of a product defect.

resource_finals.assessment: Resource admission and validity passed for all three jobs. The guest child exited 1 because the acceptance driver failed at the stale picker-button lookup; resource validity does not convert the failed guest job to an overall success.

repair_recommendation: After recording C19, explicitly click the Data-level Cancel control to clear the returned field, then wait for selectedFieldValues to be empty and for the Pick fields button to return before entering a fresh picker for Clear/C21. Alternatively, split C19 Done/handoff and Clear/selected-Cancel into independent flows with known initial state. Keep the no-pattern-write observation over the relevant action window. Do not infer that re-entering the picker clears a selected Data draft.
